jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

  • Security, Compliance & Audit Support: Ensuring platform configurations adhere to SonarSource's data protection, access control, and audit requirements. Supporting external audit engagements (KPMG, PwC) with documentation and evidence packages.

  • Stakeholder Enablement: Partnering with all internal teams (HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Security, GTM) to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and deliver continuous improvements — acting as a true internal platform consultant.

  • Platform Roadmap Contribution: Proactively identifying opportunities to modernize internal processes, adopt new platform capabilities, and drive the platform roadmap forward in partnership with the BizTech BackOffice lead


    • Experience and qualifications

    Experience & Technical Acumen

  • AI Engineering (Required): Hands-on experience with AI-native platforms and building on them — Claude/Anthropic, MCP, agent frameworks (Rovo or equivalent), connectors, and prompt-based workflows. You've built and shipped something real, not just experimented.

  • Atlassian Platform Expertise (Required): 5+ years hands-on administration of Jira Service Management (JSM), Jira Software, and Confluence Cloud in enterprise, multi-team environments. Deep knowledge of JSM request types, workflows, SLAs, queues, automations, and service catalog design.

  • Automation & Integration Engineering: Proven experience building workflow automations using Atlassian Automation and/or third-party tools. Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON for system integrations. Scripting experience (Python, Groovy, JavaScript) is a strong plus.

  • Enterprise Tool Breadth: Experience with adjacent enterprise systems — identity providers (Okta, JumpCloud), collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom), or business systems (NetSuite, BambooHR, Salesforce) — is a strong differentiator. We don't need deep expertise in all of them, but curiosity and adaptability across the stack matters.

  • CMDB / Asset Management: Experience configuring and maintaining a CMDB or IT asset management system (JSM Assets, ServiceNow CMDB, or equivalent).

  • ITSM & ITIL Knowledge: Strong understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL v3/v4 frameworks — including incident, change, problem, and request management — with the ability to configure platform workflows that enforce these processes at scale.

  • Security & Compliance Awareness: Understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC), access governance, and audit-readiness requirements. Experience supporting external audit engagements is a plus.

  • Atlassian Certifications (Plus): ACP-620 (Jira Service Management), ACP-120 (Jira Administrator), or ACP-420 (Confluence Administrator) are highly valued.

    • Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities — you see patterns others miss and turn complexity into clean solutions.

  • Highly autonomous and pragmatic: you make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect information, without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize across competing demands and manage multiple concurrent initiatives.

  • Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo — and to give and receive direct feedback in the service of continuous improvement.

  • Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluent in English, written and verbal.

  • Collaborative by nature: you share information and ideas freely, and you understand that the best solutions emerge from collective thinking.

  • Leadership mindset: you take ownership of initiatives end-to-end and drive them to completion with accountability and autonomy.

  • Values "done" over "perfect" — while continuously looking for ways to improve processes and deliver measurable impact.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Full Stack growth path)
Short-Form Video & Content Creator (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
GetMOW is one of the companies being built at Cloud Studios, a product studio in Berlin.

This role sits across the wider Cloud Studios ecosystem, not just GetMOW. Your main focus will be creating content around Cloud Studios, our team, our products and the reality of building companies from scratch.

We’re not looking for someone to sit behind a laptop all day editing corporate videos.

We’re looking for someone who walks into the office with a camera and sees content everywhere. A weird conversation becomes a video. A team moment becomes a recurring series. Something happens while building a company and you turn it into a story people actually want to watch.

Think Kinso, HeyClicky, Cluely or SULT rather than traditional B2B marketing.

Tasks

  • Own short-form video content across Cloud Studios and its products, primarily for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn.
  • Be in the office regularly, capturing what is actually happening rather than manufacturing everything from behind a desk.
  • Turn everyday startup moments, conversations, failures, wins and chaos into entertaining content.
  • Develop recurring formats, characters, series, office skits, interviews and social-first concepts.
  • Write hooks, scripts and storylines that make people stop scrolling.
  • Film and edit content from idea to finished post.
  • Be comfortable getting in front of the camera yourself when the concept calls for it.
  • Experiment constantly with formats, trends, storytelling styles and ideas.
  • Help build Cloud Studios into a brand people want to follow, not just a company they know exists.
  • Spend roughly 5 hours per week creating content specifically for GetMOW, turning topics like AI visibility, organic growth, experiments and the journey of building GetMOW into engaging content.
  • Work closely with the founders and wider team, while having significant creative ownership yourself.

The goal is simple: make content people would watch even if they had no idea what Cloud Studios or GetMOW was

Requirements

Important: This position is a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum). You must be required to complete an internship as part of your university, school or educational programme and be able to provide confirmation of this.

Beyond that, we care much more about your taste, creativity and energy than your CV.

You’re probably a good fit if:

  • You genuinely understand short-form content and internet culture.
  • You naturally think in hooks, stories, formats and “this could be a video” moments.
  • You have strong creative taste and can tell when something feels boring, forced or too corporate.
  • You can film and edit short-form video confidently.
  • You’re comfortable approaching people, asking questions and creating moments rather than waiting for them to happen.
  • You’re willing to appear on camera yourself.
  • You can work independently and turn an idea into something published without needing constant direction.
  • You’re comfortable experimenting quickly and occasionally making something that completely flops.
  • You speak fluent English.
  • You can regularly work with us in person in Berlin.
  • Ideally, you can join us for 4–6 months.

You do not need years of professional experience or a perfect portfolio. Show us that you understand content and have the creative instinct to make things people want to watch.

Benefits

  • Real creative ownership from day one. You won’t just execute someone else’s content calendar.
  • Direct access to the founders and the entire company-building process.
  • A constant stream of things to film: products being built, ideas being tested, launches, failures, team moments and everything in between.
  • Freedom to experiment with weird ideas, new formats and concepts.
  • Work across Cloud Studios and products like GetMOW rather than being stuck creating content for one brand.
  • Build a portfolio around content that actually gets published and tested in the real world.
  • Work closely with a small, ambitious team in Berlin.
  • The opportunity to take on significantly more responsibility as Cloud Studios grows.
  • Potential to transition into a paid position after the internship, depending on performance, company needs and mutual fit.

Please note: This is an unpaid mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum)

If you’re looking for a traditional social media internship where someone hands you a content calendar and asks for three Reels a week, this probably isn’t it.

We want someone who wants to build the content engine with us.

Send us examples of things you’ve made, accounts you’ve worked on, or even content you simply think represents your taste. We care less about polished applications and more about seeing how you think creatively.

If there’s a fit, we’ll start with a short conversation and take it from there.

jobs.description:
Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et la satisfaction client.

Notre objectif est clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Dans le cadre du lancement et du déploiement de nos pompes à chaleur en France, nous recherchons notre premier·ère Superviseur·ise CVC/HVAC pour superviser les installations de nos pompes à chaleur air-air. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France.

Il s’agit d’un poste sur le terrain couvrant la région d’Amiens, mais tu seras également amené·e à travailler depuis ton domicile ou depuis notre bureau de Lille lorsque cela sera nécessaire.


Ce que tu feras
- Tu nous aideras à mettre en place la structure technique de notre département dédié aux pompes à chaleur en France
- Tu veilleras à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement des installations réalisées par nos partenaires locaux
- Tu seras sur le terrain pour visiter les chantiers et t’assurer de leur bon déroulement
- Tu seras en mesure d’apporter une assistance technique pour résoudre directement tout problème identifié sur place
- Tu auras un esprit « dépanneur » pour trouver des solutions aux défis rencontrés et les résoudre à ton échelle
- Tu mettras à profit tes connaissances et ton expérience en matière d’installations de pompes à chaleur pour garantir une expérience fluide et exceptionnelle
- Tu conseilleras nos clients et tu les aideras à mettre en places les bonnes pratique de réduction des émissions carbone
- Tu examineras les cahiers des charges techniques et les plans techniques de nos pompes à chaleur, et tu pourras participer à leur élaboration/amélioration continue, en lien avec les équipes techniques & métiers du groupe

Profil recherché
- Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’installation et la maintenance de systèmes de pompes à chaleur aérothermiques
- Tu es disponible et prêt·e à te déplacer dans la région d’Amiens et le Nord de la France
- Tu es un·e technicien·ne expérimenté·e, notamment en plomberie et chauffage, et tu possèdes des connaissances en conception de systèmes de chauffage ; tu es en mesure de dépanner toi-même et d’intervenir techniquement sur place sur les chantiers
- Tu sais examiner et être force de proposition sur des cahiers des charges techniques ainsi que des plans mécaniques
- Tu as l'esprit entrepreneur : tu rejoins un nouveau projet où "tout est à faire". Tu n’as pas peur de partir d'une feuille blanche, tester, apprendre et avancer en autonomie.
- Tu es proactif·ve et rigoureux·se, tu sais organiser ton activité en autonomie, en optimisant au fur et à mesure, notamment en mettant en place des processus clairs et automatisés
- Tu as le goût du challenge, tu aimes aller sur le terrain ; tu n'as pas peur de te confronter aux artisans et de les aider à surmonter les irritants rencontrés. Doté·e d'un fort capital sympathie, tu sais fédérer tes interlocuteurs et les faire devenir de véritables ambassadeurs d’Octopus Energy !



Pré-requis & Qualifications

- Permis voiture en cours de validité
- Diplôme(s) de niveau CAP/BEP, ou VAE de niveau équivalent
- Avoir travaillé précédemment dans des entreprises certifiées RGE & Qualibat 
- Maîtrise de l’anglais technique à l’écrit & l’oral (niveau B1-B2) 
- Habilitation électrique (BR NF C18-510)

Ce sera également un plus si :
- Tu es à l’aise avec les outils & le numérique, notamment Excel
- Tu as de l’expérience avec la partie “électrique” des pompes à chaleur 
- Tu possèdes l’habilitation électrique BR

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

Treasury Manager (ALM)
jobs.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Treasury is where Mollie's balance sheet takes shape, this team makes sure that our balance sheet is safe, well-funded and resilient. You, as Treasury Manager, will be one of the first people building the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) function for Mollie.

This is a genuine 0-to-1 role. There is no legacy ALM framework to maintain, no existing ILAAP to update, no established models to inherit. You'll help design and build the liquidity risk framework, the interest rate and credit spread risk approach, and the funding and balance sheet strategy. Your work will feed directly into Mollie’s licence application and, once authorised, into how Mollie actually manages its liquidity and funding risks.

You'll work closely with our product teams, Finance, and Risk Domains and your analysis will be seen by senior leadership and, eventually, by our regulator. As Mollie moves from application to operation, your scope will grow from building the framework to running it.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own the core building blocks of Mollie liquidity risk framework, including the ILAAP, LCR/NSFR monitoring, and liquidity stress testing.

  • Develop Mollie’s approach to interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB), from risk identification through to models, limits and hedging strategy.

  • Contribute to the design of Mollie’s funding and balance sheet strategy, including deposit mix, funding diversification and balance sheet construction.

  • Build the Contingency Funding Plan and related early-warning indicators, so Mollie knows exactly what to do under stress before it needs to.

  • Produce clear, well-documented policies, methodologies and models that will stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors, and Mollie's own second and third lines of defense.

  • Support senior leadership (ALCO or its future equivalent) with the analysis, reporting and recommendations it needs to make sound balance sheet decisions.

  • Partner with Risk, Finance and our external advisors, to make sure Treasury's frameworks are consistent with Mollie’s wider risk appetite and governance.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5+ years of experience in Treasury, ALM or balance sheet risk management, ideally within a bank, though experience in a fintech, PSP or consultancy building similar frameworks is also relevant.

  • Solid working knowledge of liquidity risk (LCR/NSFR, ILAAP) and/or interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB). You don't need to be deep in both, but you understand how they connect to the balance sheet as a whole.

  • Comfort building models and frameworks from a blank page. You're not looking for a well-worn playbook, you're excited to write the first one.

  • Strong quantitative and Excel/financial modelling skills, with the discipline to document your logic clearly enough that someone else, including a regulator, can follow it.

  • The ability to explain complex balance sheet risk topics clearly to non-specialists, and the confidence to defend your recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of this work that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgment and design.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

If you're excited by the idea of building a bank's Treasury function from scratch, for Mollie and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance and banking with us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Stealth AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description:
What we're building

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that turns machine and operational data into knowledge people can act on: for troubleshooting, for decisions, and for automation.

We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding team.

The role

You'll build the software that makes sense of what happens on a manufacturing floor. That includes sensor measurements, actuator states, quality measurements, and operational events, streamed from connected machines and autonomous systems. Our platform processes this data to power analysis and automated workflows.

We work AI-first. Our coding agents know our platform and our engineering practices, and you'll use them every day. You're still the engineer, though. You'll review every line, understand what it does, and test it properly. That frees you to focus on the application, the industrial domain, and the quality of the system.

We care about what you can show, how fast you learn, and whether you take ownership. Seniority and years of experience matter less.

What you'll do

  • Own features end to end: understand the problem, choose the approach, then build, test, ship, and follow up

  • Get to know the existing codebase in depth, including its architecture, dependencies, data flows, and failure modes

  • Write code with AI tools and review each change line by line for correctness, maintainability, security, and impact on the wider system

  • Build meaningful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and wire them into CI

  • Test against messy real-world data, using recorded streams, representative datasets, and simulated devices. Cover missing or delayed measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values, and dropped connections

  • Reproduce failures, fix them, and add regression tests so they don't return. Make sure tests reflect the intended behavior, and challenge the assumptions in the implementation

  • Build and improve backend services, APIs, and data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval, and automated workflows

  • Learn how our users and their factories work, so you can spot the right improvements and make good engineering calls

  • Help wherever it's needed: integration, deployment, documentation, and technical investigation. Flag progress, capacity, trade-offs, and blockers early

You might be a fit if you

  • Write strong, practical Python and understand the advanced features and patterns used in production code

  • Have built and maintained substantial software: finding your way in an existing codebase, debugging behavior you've never seen before, and shipping reliable changes

  • Think like a tester: you turn requirements into test cases, set sensible test boundaries, build useful test data, and dig into failures

  • Have solid fundamentals in software design, APIs, data handling, testing, debugging, and version control

  • Can explain what code does, why it works, where it could break, and how to verify it, including code an AI helped write

  • Like AI coding tools, use them a lot, and stay critical of their output, because you own the result

  • Break down unfamiliar problems, investigate on your own, and ask sharp questions when you need to

  • Find the next useful step yourself and keep moving without being told what to do

  • Are comfortable with shifting priorities, varying workloads, and a broad scope, and communicate and prioritize clearly

  • Write and speak clear English

A degree is optional. We care about evidence that you can engineer, not about a title or a specific path.

Bonus points

Depth in one of these areas makes you a particularly strong candidate. We don't expect all three.

  • ML and industrial data: strong ML fundamentals and hands-on work with time-series, sensor, machine, or robotics data. You've dealt with data quality, evaluated models, and turned results into useful product behavior

  • Agents, autonomous systems, and industrial automation: agent coordination, workflow orchestration, state management, or failure handling. IIoT experience, such as telemetry pipelines, device interfaces, MQTT, or OPC UA, is a big plus

  • Knowledge graphs and retrieval: knowledge representation, graph database design, schema and relationship modeling, graph queries, or retrieval that connects structured knowledge to what the application needs

Also useful: cloud deployment, containers, and testing software against simulators or physical devices.

Why now

You'll be one of the first engineers. Your code goes to production, and your decisions shape the product and how we build it. You'll work directly with the founders from day one. We'll tell you more about the company, the founders, and our backers in the first conversation.

jobs.description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.

Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.

Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week.

jobs.title: Agentic Compiler Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

You will contribute to areas such as:

  • Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations.

  • Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation.

  • Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies.

  • Verification and correctness checks for generated changes.

  • GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization.

  • LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication.

  • Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs.

One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn.

Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO.

Relevant experience includes:

  • Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR.

  • GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies.

  • GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior.

  • LLM inference engines and performance optimization.

  • Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution.

  • Formal verification, equivalence checking, SAT/SMT, or related methods.

  • Systems that generate, search, test, benchmark, or optimize code automatically.

We care about what you personally built and the technical decisions behind it. Strong candidates can explain the problem, their approach, the alternatives they explored, and how they measured the result.

We review technical work during the process. This can be public code, an upstream contribution, a paper, a thesis, a technical project, or a detailed write-up based on work you can share.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join a small team building AGCO as a core part of Kog's technology.

  • Work at the intersection of compilers, GPU systems, and LLM inference.

  • Direct access to engineers working across the full inference stack.

  • A fast loop from an optimization idea to compilation, execution, verification, and measurement on real GPUs.

  • The opportunity to go deep in your strongest technical area while expanding into the other parts of the stack.

  • High ownership over technical decisions and systems that will shape how Kog optimizes LLM inference.

This role is based in Paris, and we are looking for candidates who can relocate to Paris and work closely with the team.

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & Full-Funnel Growth - 100% remote
jobs.description:
Wir sind eine stark wachsende Direct-to-Consumer-Marke im Gesundheitsbereich und verkaufen hochwertige Supplements direkt an unsere Kund:innen. Unsere wichtigste Wachstumsmaschine: Direct-Response-Marketing über Meta Ads.

Ein hoher ROAS ist für uns kein Ziel – meistens ist er ein Zeichen dafür, dass zu wenig ausgegeben wird. Wir steuern auf Wachstum: Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und ein CAC, der sich am Kundenwert misst. Wenn du ohnehin in Deckungsbeiträgen und CAC/CLV denkst statt in Plattformkennzahlen, ist das hier dein Standard. Wenn nicht, ist es die falsche Stelle.

Wir suchen jemanden, der den kompletten Funnel von der Ad über das Offer und die Landingpage bis zum Kauf als ein System versteht, systematisch testet und Budget dorthin bringt, wo es profitables Wachstum erzeugt – auch wenn das auf Plattformebene erstmal unbequem aussieht.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Media Buying auf Wachstum steuern: Du verantwortest unsere Paid-Social-Konten eigenständig – Budget, Kampagnensetup, Adsets, Creatives einbuchen. Du skalierst, solange die Unit Economics tragen, und skalierst nicht, um Plattformmetriken zu schonen.
  • Full-Funnel-Diagnose: Du analysierst regelmäßig den gesamten Weg von Ad über Offer und Landingpage bis zur Conversion, findest den größten Engpass und priorisierst genau dort.
  • Creative Testing & Creative Diversity: Du entwickelst Testhypothesen, bewertest Creative-Performance und sorgst dafür, dass das Konto nicht von zwei Winning Ads abhängt: verschiedene Angles, Formate, Creator und Hooks parallel im Test, damit Skalierung nicht an Creative Fatigue scheitert. Learnings gehen konkret und datenbasiert an Creative Strategist und Copywriting zurück.
  • Offer- und Landingpage-Tests koordinieren: Du priorisierst den Test-Backlog für Bundles, Preislogik, Value Stack, Message-Match und Landingpage-Struktur, briefst die Fachteams, wertest aus und rollst Gewinner aus.
  • Steuerung nach Gesamtwirtschaftlichkeit: Deine Entscheidungsgrundlage sind Neukunden, CM3, aMER, MER und CAC im Verhältnis zum Kundenwert – nicht der ROAS einer einzelnen Kampagne.
  • Attribution & Datenqualität: Du liest Performance nicht aus dem Ads Manager, sondern aus unserem Attributionsmodell. Du weißt, wo Plattform-Attribution und Realität auseinanderlaufen, sorgst für saubere Datenerfassung und klärst Auffälligkeiten früh mit IT.
  • Struktur & Reporting: Einheitliche Naming Convention, nachvollziehbare Account-Struktur, feste Reporting- und Review-Routinen für Wachstum, Budget und Learnings.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Media Buying für Meta Ads im D2C-Kontext – du hast eigenverantwortlich Budgets gesteuert und ein Konto profitabel wachsen lassen, nicht nur effizient gehalten.
  • Du kannst erklären, warum ein Konto mit ROAS 1,0 und wachsendem Neukundenstamm mehr wert ist als eines mit ROAS 4 und stagnierendem Umsatz – und du hast das schon einmal jemandem erklären müssen.
  • Du denkst in Funnels und Kohorten: Du weißt, dass ein schlechter Neukunden-CAC auch am Offer oder an der Landingpage liegen kann, und dass der Wert eines Neukunden erst nach dem ersten Kauf entsteht.
  • Testgetrieben: Du setzt Tests mit klarer Hypothese, Erfolgskriterium und Auswertungslogik auf und dokumentierst, was du lernst.
  • Sicher in Datenanalyse und Attribution – du hast mit Attributionstools jenseits des Ads Managers gearbeitet, kennst die Grenzen von Plattform-Attribution und Tracking-Setups (Pixel, CAPI, UTMs) und erkennst, wenn Daten nicht stimmen.
  • Du kennst gängige DR-Mechaniken (Hook–Problem–Solution, Value Stack, Social Proof, Scarcity) und kannst beurteilen, warum ein Creative oder Offer performt.
  • Du weißt, dass Creative Diversity kein Kreativ-Nice-to-have ist, sondern die Voraussetzung dafür, dass ein Konto skaliert – und planst deinen Testing-Mix entsprechend.
  • Du arbeitest gern mit Creative-, Copy- und Web-Teams zusammen – als Taktgeber mit klaren Briefings, nicht als Einzelkämpfer.
  • AI-Tools für Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung und Creative-Analyse nutzt du bereits
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Supplement- oder Health-Brands.

🛠 So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Du bekommst volle Verantwortung für die Paid-Social-Konten und ein Team, das zusammen mit dir Creatives, Copy, Landingpages und Tracking bearbeitet – du priorisierst, was gerade am Wichtigsten ist.
  • Du steuerst mit denselben Zahlen wie die Geschäftsführung: CM3, aMER, MER, Neukunden, Kundenwert. Kein separates „Marketing-Dashboard", das schöner aussieht als die Realität.
  • Wir arbeiten mit Notion für Prozesse, Slack fürs Team und einem eigenen Attributionsstack, in den wir laufend investieren – du steuerst nach diesen Zahlen, nicht nach Meta's Zahlen.
  • Rollen sind bei uns klar definiert: Objective, Job Results, KPIs. Du weißt, wofür du verantwortlich bist – und was nicht.
  • Entscheidungen fallen auf Basis von Daten. Wenn die Daten fehlen, holen wir sie, bevor wir raten.

Benefits

Was dich erwartet

  • Eine Marke mit klarer Positionierung und Produkten, perfekt für unsere Zielgruppe – und eine Organisation, die Paid Social als Wachstumsmotor denkt, nicht als Kostenstelle.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, echtes Mandat über Budget und Testing.
  • Regelmäßige Performance-Reviews und Learnings – wir skalieren, was funktioniert, und dokumentieren, warum.
  • Remote-Only mit klaren Prozessen und hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Die Möglichkeit, das Performance-Marketing-System einer wachsenden Health-Brand von Grund auf mitzubauen – und mit ihr zu wachsen.

Let's grow it!

Du denkst in Full-Funnel, Neukunden, Deckungsbeiträgen und hast den den CLV im Blick?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, zwei bis drei konkreten Beispielen, in denen du Meta Ads mit Direct Response Mechaniken zum Wachstum geführt hast und einem kurzen Statement, warum du in unser Team gehörst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich.

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

Edinburgh
London

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

You'll hunt and close new business with major UK retail and brand clients, with full ownership of your own pipeline, start to finish. But you'll also be the one landing new platform and marketplace partnerships from scratch, sitting across the table from partnerships teams at the biggest names in e-commerce and walking out with a deal that changes our reach overnight. It's a bigger seat than the title suggests, built for someone who's outgrown what a standard AE role can offer them.

What You'll Do

  • Work hand in hand with our engineers to get integrations built, certified, and live

  • Build partnerships that outlast any single deal, the relationships you land become permanent infrastructure for how we grow

  • Represent the business at the industry's biggest events, turning rooms full of decision makers into potential pipeline

  • Shape what gets prioritised next, this isn't a fixed list handed down from above, it's yours to help shape

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

  • 6+ years experience running genuinely complex, multi-stakeholder new business sales cycles and winning, repeatedly, against real competition.

  • You're commercially sharp first, technically fluent second. You don't need to code, but you can walk into a room with a platform's BD team and be treated as a peer, not just a vendor.

  • You're bored by roles that only ask for one skill, hunting new logos and originating strategic partnerships both genuinely excite you.

  • You help build the playbook rather than wait for others to guide you.

  • Bonus points if you already speak fluent parcel, logistics, or e-commerce platform, but how you operate matters more than where you've been

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

 

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

jobs.description:
Du willst nicht nur Social Media managen, sondern selbst das Gesicht einer Marke werden?

BuddySIM macht mobiles Internet auf Reisen einfach. Mit unseren eSIMs können Reisende in über 190 Ländern direkt online gehen: 100% ohne Roaming-Stress, SIM-Kartenwechsel oder komplizierte Tarife.

Jetzt wollen wir unsere Marke auf Social Media auf das nächste Level bringen. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Lust hat, vor der Kamera zu stehen, Menschen anzusprechen und gemeinsam mit uns Content zu entwickeln, der auffällt.

Du wirst eines der Gesichter von BuddySIM auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts und weiteren Plattformen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du stehst regelmäßig selbst vor der Kamera und repräsentierst BuddySIM auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Formate, Reels, TikToks und wiederkehrende Content-Serien.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und führst beispielsweise spontane Interviews, Straßenumfragen oder Reise-Challenges durch.

  • Du beobachtest Trends und erkennst früh, welche Formate, Sounds und Themen Potenzial haben.

  • Du entwickelst Ideen, Hooks, Storylines und Skripte.

  • Du produzierst authentischen Content von der Idee über den Dreh bis zum fertigen Video.

  • Du begleitest Events, Reisen, Kooperationen oder Aktionen mit der Kamera.

  • Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine wiedererkennbare Social-Media-Persönlichkeit für BuddySIM auf.

  • Du analysierst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und entwickelst unsere Formate kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du managed Kooperationen mit anderen Creatoren:innen.

Das solltest du mitbringen

Du bist kommunikativ, spontan und kannst Menschen mit deiner Art mitnehmen.

Außerdem wäre ideal, wenn du:

  • dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst und authentisch auftreten kannst,

  • offen und selbstbewusst auf fremde Menschen zugehst,

  • TikTok, Instagram und aktuelle Social-Media-Trends wirklich verstehst,

  • ein gutes Gespür für Humor, Storytelling und interessante Hooks hast,

  • kreative Ideen nicht nur vorschlägst, sondern auch direkt umsetzen möchtest,

  • eigenständig arbeiten und Verantwortung für eigene Formate übernehmen kannst,

  • grundlegende Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt mitbringst,

  • Lust auf Reisen und internationale Themen hast,

  • sehr gutes Deutsch sprichst; Englisch ist ein Plus.

Ein klassischer Lebenslauf oder ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns deutlich weniger wichtig als Persönlichkeit, Kreativität und dein Gefühl für Social Media.

Was dich bei BuddySIM erwartet

BuddySIM ist ein wachsendes Travel-Tech-Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Wir wollen keine austauschbare Corporate-Kommunikation produzieren, sondern Social Media machen, das Menschen tatsächlich anschauen möchten.

Bei uns bekommst du:

  • sehr viel kreativen Freiraum,

  • die Möglichkeit, eigene Formate von Grund auf aufzubauen,

  • kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Umsetzung,

  • direkten Austausch mit dem Gründerteam,

  • moderne Tools und Equipment für deine Content-Produktion,

  • ein junges, dynamisches Umfeld,

  • die Möglichkeit, bei Reisen, Events und besonderen Aktionen dabei zu sein,

  • und vor allem die Chance, eine sichtbare Persönlichkeit unserer Marke zu werden.

Wer perfekt zu uns passt

Vielleicht produzierst du bereits selbst TikToks oder Reels.

Vielleicht bist du die Person in deinem Freundeskreis, die problemlos mit jedem ins Gespräch kommt.

Vielleicht hast du bisher noch nie professionell Social Media gemacht, weißt aber ganz genau, warum manche Videos Millionen Views bekommen und andere niemanden interessieren.

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Interesse?

Dann schick uns keinen Roman.

Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und gerne direkt ein kurzes Video, in dem du dich vorstellst.

Bonus: Schick uns eine Idee für ein TikTok oder Reel, das du für BuddySIM drehen würdest.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

We are seeking a highly experienced and client-focused capital markets professional to take ownership of a portfolio of quantitative equity indices while serving as a trusted partner to a global client base. jobs.title: Associate Product Manager | London
jobs.description:
We Are

Breaking The Law


LawAdvisor was founded in 2015 in Melbourne, Australia with a fearless and ambitious belief: that everybody should have access to justice.

We hypothesised that the high costs, inefficiencies, and difficulties of obtaining legal help could be overcome simply by providing greater access to legal information, and by providing everybody with real-time access to high-quality, affordable lawyers online.

Our mission has since been supported by thousands of lawyers and has allowed us to expand and set up offices across the globe. We've also attracted high-profile investors and partners who have shared our mission to transform legal service delivery.


We're still not satisfied. The potential exists to completely revolutionise the practice of law. The start of this decade has delivered LawAdvisor with a new mandate: to overhaul and transform how lawyers work, and how people interact with and consume legal services, with state-of-the-art legal practise management technology to (i) increase efficiencies; (ii) automate routine processes; (iii) increase transparency; (iv) bring the legal practice to the 21st century.



We Need

A Novice Juggler
Our Associate Product Manager relishes in the idea of being a part of a team that moves mountains. They know better than to falter when opportunities aren’t handed to them because they know that nothing good will ever come easy. Remaining steadfast and diligent, they’re prepared to get their hands dirty and navigate through the variety of tasks that they’ll take ownership over.


Teaming up with our Product Managers, you’ll solve problems and facilitate communication across our cross-functional team and align them in order to shape, influence, and refine our products. An intimate understanding of our market and product suite helps us surmount any obstacle facing us whether it may be competitors, client and stakeholder feedback, or the creation of new products and features. You’ll be ready to learn from the best and continuously supercharge your professional growth and knowledge through our resources, tools, and first-hand experience.


You Will

  • Be the professor of our users’ “pain points”. You empathise with our clients and can describe the problems we are trying to solve.

  • Collaborate with and manage the product development team alongside the Product Manager.

  • Gather, analyse, and apply our quantitative and qualitative data and feedback to elevate our products.

  • Ideate new solutions and opportunities as well as analyse research with the product team to determine how it can align with our product goals.

  • Help facilitate communication within cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle from conceptualisation to launch day and beyond.

  • Use your in-depth understanding of our products to deliver training to our internal teams and external stakeholders to promote optimal product knowledge.

  • Learn and grow: gain knowledge and experience through watching and/or participating in the creation of product roadmaps, product strategy, and product plans as they happen.

  • Become a leader: you gain first-hand experience through the Product Manager on how to delegate, manage and lead cross-functional teams to product success.


You Should Have

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Business Management, Marketing, a similar related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as an Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Scrum Master, or practical experience in the development and/or launch of a product.

  • Experience working both autonomously and in cross-functional teams.

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills: you are an essential part of our communication as you harmonise the voices, needs, and concerns of our stakeholders, product team, and clients.

  • The ability to build domain and industry knowledge quickly.


Bonus Points

  • Thrive under pressure.

  • Experience in the development and launch of a product or feature.

  • Demonstrated skill in UX design, software engineering, software quality assurance or marketing.

  • Previous experience in a startup environment.

  • Experience working with a remote team.

  • Experience working in the legal services industry.


We’ll Offer

  • A highly skilled, driven, and dedicated team.

  • Remote work opportunities: our team is distributed across the globe and we enjoy the flexibility of working remotely when possible.

  • Continuous learning and development: whether by way of conferences, online courses, or further study, we’re here to support your personal and professional growth.

  • Company gatherings: while we operate over Zoom and Slack, our company gatherings allow us to create long-lasting bonds with each other and to feel human.

  • A direct line with our key users, and influential high-level stakeholders (investors, advisors, and other relevant members) to use as and when needed.

jobs.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

In this role you own all of finance at Superchat end to end and report directly to the founders. When the board or our investors have a question about the numbers, you're the one who answers it.
You'll take over our financial model and turn it into something the whole company can steer by. You'll own accounting through to the P&L, run forecasting and liquidity planning, and lead the annual audit.

Who We Want

7+ years of finance experience.
You know the full cycle first-hand, from closing to forecast to board reporting.

Closing and audit expertise.
You independently own monthly and annual closings under HGB, including revenue recognition and accruals, and you coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors through to completed financial statements.

Expert financial modelling.
You build driver-based, integrated three-statement models from scratch and you document them so that others can operate them too.

Forecasting.
You've owned full budget and forecast cycles, you bring together top-down targets and bottom-up input from team leads, and you treat forecast accuracy as a measurable figure that has to improve.

Business partner.
You deliver a reasoned recommendation, not just the numbers and you follow up on whether it gets implemented.

Experience with investors and the board.
You've prepared and presented board materials, and you've been through a financial due diligence - ideally on the company side.
Bridges finance and startup culture. You bring the rigour a finance function demands, while working productively with fast decisions and shifting priorities.

Appetite for automation.
You actively look for ways to take manual work out of the close and the reporting cycle, so the team's time goes into analysis rather than assembly.

Strong communicator.
You translate complex financial data into clear narratives for stakeholders without a finance background, and you're confident in the room with founders, board and investors. Fluent German and English, written and verbal.

Who We Don't Want

Manages the status quo.
You run an inherited function competently, but you don't develop it further.

Reports instead of advising.
You deliver numbers without drawing a recommendation from them, and consider the job done once the report is sent.

Treats the model as personal property.
You build something only you can operate with undocumented logic and manual overrides nobody else can follow. Uncomfortable in front of investors.

Looking for predictability.
You need stable priorities and permanently fixed responsibilities.

Your Day To Day

Financial Model & Steering (~30%)

  • You own and maintain our driver-based financial model documented, operable by others, and reconciled to actuals every month
  • You own forecasting, budgeting, liquidity and runway planning, and the management of cash conversion
  • You own headcount planning together with the founders, People and team leads
  • You evaluate business cases for new products, markets and pricing models, and act as a sparring partner to the founders on strategic decisions

Accounting, Tax & Audit (~30%)

  • You own bookkeeping and monthly, quarterly and annual closings under HGB, with clean revenue recognition and accruals
  • You coordinate the annual audit with our external auditors end to end, through to completed financial statements
  • You manage the relationship with our tax advisors and ensure tax obligations are met
  • You own AR, AP and payment processes, and a cost centre structure that scales with the company

KPIs & Business Partnering (~20%)

  • You define and monitor the metrics each team steers by - engagement, conversion, retention - as inputs to the model rather than a separate reporting exercise
  • You sit in the business reviews, translate numbers into concrete recommendations, and follow up on execution
  • You deliver month-end variance analysis and management reporting as a clear, action-oriented narrative rather than a data dump
  • You analyse revenue, margin and cost development at customer, product and channel level

Funding & Investor Relations (~20%)

  • You build and continuously maintain our data room so we're due-diligence-ready at any time
  • You lead the financial due diligence on our side and support the next funding round end to end
  • You own investor reporting and communication on a monthly and quarterly cadence, as well as the board reporting packages
  • You maintain relationships with investors, banks and financing partners

Stakeholders

Founders & Leadership Team: your most important counterpart day-to-day, from annual planning to ongoing prioritisation and the most consequential financial decisions

Team Leads across Sales, Marketing, Product & Customer Success: for KPI definition, budget ownership and business reviews

Board & Investors: for monthly and quarterly reporting, board meetings and funding rounds

External Partners: tax advisors, auditors, banks and financing partners

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club/John Reed membership or a public transport/Dance subscription
  • Regular company and team events
  • Annual personal development budget of €500 for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that enables fast professional and personal growth
  • Beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment

We want to build a community, not just a company.

It’s important to us to create an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together - whether that’s through HYROX training, golfing, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or whatever kind of community you’d like to help build here!

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.
  • Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted.
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
  • You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value.
  • You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation.
